# Test fixtures

`munich_altstadt_excerpt.osm` and `munich_roofs.osm` are **real OpenStreetMap data** (see the last bullets); every other file in
this folder is **synthetic**: generated by map-builder's test helpers, not real geographic data.

* `synthetic_area.osm`: hand-built OSM XML (generator "map-builder SYNTHETIC test fixture").
  It covers buildings (gabled, hipped, courtyard, `building:part`, `min_height`), roads, a
  bridge (reported as unsupported) and a road tunnel (way/1072, generated as a tube), water, trees and an invalid bow-tie
  outline. The node coordinates are placed near 47.0°N 8.0°E for convenience only. They do
  not describe that real location.
* `synthetic_dem.asc`: ESRI ASCII grid of an analytic sloped/undulating surface (vertical
  datum reported as `SYNTHETIC`).

The synthetic files contain no OpenStreetMap or Copernicus data and need no licence.
`examples/synthetic_sample.mbmap` is built from them with a fixed `--created-utc`, so the build is
byte-reproducible. The exact command is in [examples/README.md](../../examples/README.md), and
`tests/test_examples.py` fails if the committed sample goes stale. The build passes `--osm-license` so the sample is not credited as OpenStreetMap/ODbL.

* `munich_altstadt_excerpt.osm`: an excerpt (OSM ways near two spots plus a few chosen ways, user/changeset metadata stripped) of the 400 x 400 m area of `tools/demo/presets/munich-altstadt.json`, fetched from Overpass on 2026-11-19. (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. It carries the same attribution in its `<note>` element and is used only by `tests/test_real_data_munich.py`. It contains no Copernicus data.

* `munich_roofs.osm`: **real OpenStreetMap data**, the 67 buildings (ways and multipolygon relations, with their nodes) of the same 400 x 400 m area that carry a non-flat `roof:shape` and are generated by v0.3.0; tags kept, user/changeset metadata stripped, coordinates rounded to 7 decimals. (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright (also in its `<note>`). Provenance: Overpass response of 2026-11-20 (`osm_base` 2026-11-20T05:53:50Z, SHA-256 `5571C3ABC2869F7ED2F48552549C7259037C379A5D940A5B22ED4B310258A72E`) for the area's geographic bbox with a 30 m margin (map-builder's `overpass_query`; s=48.13743148, w=11.57330947, n=48.14156847, e=11.57949053) (about 2 h newer than the v0.3.0 demo acquisition, `osm_base` 2026-11-20T03:40:03Z; the building count of 148 and the 67 roof cases are identical). The snapshot is committed so tests never go online. Used only by `tests/test_roofs_munich.py`. No Copernicus data.
* `munich_roofs_expected.json`: per building the tagged shape, the eave and roof height (m above the base datum), the outcome of v0.3.0 (`built_shape`, `roof_shape_provenance`, `built_as_tagged`, `failed_checks`; 2 v0.3.0 gabled quads are built as gabled but fail `planar` by 2 mm and 33 mm) and the skeleton eligibility class (`already_built`, `eligible`, or `out_of_scope` with a reason; collinear tolerance 0.01 m, at most 64 vertices). The heights are those v0.3.0 gives the tagged shape (the tagged shape is forced through `resolve_shape`, so fallback buildings get the roof height a successful roof would get). Built over a flat DEM (z = 0), `PlanOptions(trees=False)`. Regenerate at the v0.3.0 tag (eb134a1) by copying `tests/test_roofs_munich.py` and `tests/roof_checks.py` into a v0.3.0 checkout and running `py -3 -m tests.test_roofs_munich --snapshot FULL.osm munich_roofs.osm` then `py -3 -m tests.test_roofs_munich --freeze munich_roofs.osm munich_roofs_expected.json`. Do not re-freeze from newer code: S3-SKELETON changes the `BASELINE` constant in the test, not this file's v0.3.0 outcomes.
* `roof_counterexamples.osm`: **synthetic** footprints (no real data; ids 9001-9007) tagged gabled/hipped with `building:levels=3`: 9001 self-touching ring (invalid), 9002 0.05 m sliver edge, 9003 near-collinear vertex run, 9004 courtyard (multipolygon relation), 9005 80-vertex near-circle, 9006 U shape (hipped), 9007 deep L (gabled).
